'''Giora Yaron''' ({{langx|he|גיורא ירון}}; born 1948) is a doctor of physics, businessman, and chairman of the board of directors of the [[Tel Aviv University]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron |url=https://telem.openu.ac.il/hp_files/chais/08/docs/Giora_Yaron-short_bio.pdf |website=The Open University of Israel}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Dr. Giora Yaron: Startups need carrots not sticks |url=http://www.globes.co.il/en/article-dr-giora-yaron-high-tech-needs-carrots-not-sticks-1001190479 |website=globes |date=28 May 2017 |publisher=Shlomit Lan}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron to Head Board of Tel Aviv University |url=https://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/Flash.aspx/200811 |website=israelnationalnews}}</ref>

== Early years ==
Yaron was born in Kibbutz, [[Manara,_Israel|Manara]] to Dan and Giza Yaron. In the IDF, Yaron served in the 12th Battalion (Barak) of the Golani Brigade, and completed an officers' course. He holds a BA (Graduated summa cum laude) in Physics and Mathematics and a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in applied physics from the Hebrew University.<ref>{{cite web |title=מקבלי תארים באוניברסיטה העברית בירושלים |url=http://jpress.org.il/Olive/APA/NLI_Heb/SharedView.Article.aspx?parm=UYjgboc201renJyaGUsINmyEKEGvcVrscTp%2FegQDVYwdN9Ic2oMXWi86LOCj9dNdYw%3D%3D&mode=image&href=MAR%2f1975%2f06%2f18&page=23&rtl=true |website=jpress}}</ref> In 1992, he managed the Indigo digital printing company (founded by [[Benny Landa]]) in [[Ness Ziona]], and in 1994 led it to an IPO on NASDAQ.<ref>{{cite web |title=Giora Yaron |url=https://finder.startupnationcentral.org/angel_page/giora-yaron |website=startupnationcentral }}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

== Establishment of companies ==
* [[Itamar Medical]] – 1997-2022, founder and chairman. <ref>{{cite web |title=Giora Yaron Ph.D. |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/person.asp?personId=656946&privcapId=2689294 |website=bloomberg}}</ref> 
* P-Cube – 1999-2004, co-founder and chairman. <ref>{{cite news |title=Dr. Giora Yaron: Startups need carrots not sticks |url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-dr-giora-yaron-high-tech-needs-carrots-not-sticks-1001190479 |website=globes|date=28 May 2017 }}</ref>
* Qwilt – 2010-Today, co-founder and board member. <ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron Independent Director and Co-founder |url=https://qwilt.com/board/dr-giora-yaron/ |website=qwilt}}</ref>
* Hyperwise- Founding Investor and board member.<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron BIOGRAPHY |url=http://investors.amdocs.com/phoenix.zhtml?c=113915&p=irol-govBio&ID=201862 |website=amdocs}}</ref> 
* Siraj Technologies – 2017-Today, co-founder and chairman. <ref>{{cite web |title=Israeli Tech Veteran Giora Yaron Wants to Bring Israel's Bedouins Into the Tech Fold |url=https://www.calcalistech.com/ctech/articles/0,7340,L-3738397,00.html |website=calcalistech |date=18 May 2018 |publisher=Hagar Ravet}}</ref>

== Business exits ==
Yaron was involved in a few exits.<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron Director |url=http://investors.amdocs.com/phoenix.zhtml?c=113915&p=irol-govBio&ID=201862 |website=investors.amdocs.}}</ref> such as: 
* Comsys - Part of Comsys was sold to Conexant (1996). The other part was sold to Texas Instruments (2005).<ref>{{cite web |title=Giora Yaron, Director or Lump? |url=https://www.haaretz.com/1.4856529 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181127195147/https://www.haaretz.com/1.4856529 |url-status=dead |archive-date=November 27, 2018 |website=haaretz |publisher=Guy Rolnik}}</ref> 
* [[P-Cube]] - sold to Cisco(2004).<ref>{{cite web |title=Cisco buys P-Cube for $200m |url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-827140 |website=globes|date=23 August 2004 }}</ref>
* Qumranet - sold to Red Hat (2008)<ref>{{cite news |title=אחד מהאבות המייסדים של ההיי-טק הישראלי: כך תקום המובילאיי הבאה |url=https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001188928 |website=globes |date = 20 May 2017|publisher=שלומית לן|last1 = לן|first1 = שלומית}}</ref>
* Hyperwise - sold to Check Point (2015)<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron - Chairman of the Executive Council,Tel Aviv University |url=https://cyberweek.tau.ac.il/2015/index.php/speakers/259-speaker-179 |website=cyberweek}}</ref>

* Member of the Advisory Committee to the Minister of Defense on technological aspects of commemoration<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Giora Yaron Chairman |url=https://cyberweek.tau.ac.il/2017/about/speakers/item/182-giora-yaron |website=cyberweek}}</ref>
* Member of the Board of Directors of Qwilt, Excelero, Equalum.<ref>{{cite news |title=Israeli data beaming co Equalum raises $5m |url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-israeli-data-beaming-co-equalum-raises-5m-1001211058 |website=globes |date=11 September 2017 |publisher=Globes correspondent}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Yaron lives in Caesarea.<ref>{{cite web |title=our itin erary - American Friends of Tel Aviv University |url=https://www.aftau.org/file/2013_Campus_and_Beyond_Itinerary.pdf |website=aftau |access-date=2018-11-12 |archive-date=2016-10-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161018201203/http://www.aftau.org/file/2013_Campus_and_Beyond_Itinerary.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> His wife Zila passed away in 2024. In her memory, he established the ''Zila Yaron Prize'', awarded to an Israeli artist who lives and works in Israel.<ref>{{cite news |title='Open rebellion against the Gaza war? That's not part of our DNA' |work=[[Haaretz]] |location=Tel Aviv |date=27 July 2025 |id={{Proquest|3233920438}} }}</ref>
